title: How a Trump Envoy Uses Vodka and Dirty Jokes to Conduct U.S. Diplomacy
summary_full: The diplomat, John Coale, says his personalized approach gets results and matches the president’s style. Critics contend he is giving up too much to an authoritarian leader.
